workResult.summary: Executed only Skill 04 Research Analysis after fail-closed admission, deterministic SHA-256 verification of the authoritative generated Analysis prompt, complete reading of all seven required control/editorial/evidence sources, durable same-date Wake Receipt verification, repository-granted global-serial execution authority and a verified Worker Claimed event. Consumed only the three completed 2026-08-29 Reading Results and produced exactly three Research Objects. Q-20260829-01 concludes that resumable Agent runtimes should separate reconstruction authority from execution authority: an eligible surviving full WorldState snapshot can legitimately restore context continuity while weaker or compaction-superseded state is rejected, but permission-bearing restored state still needs current policy/resource revalidation before action. Q-20260829-02 concludes that workspace trust becomes enforceable governance only when it directly shapes capability admission: negative or unresolved trust should narrow the effective executable surface before materialization, while live revocation of already-created capabilities remains a separate lifecycle control. Q-20260829-03 concludes that bounded execution must follow lifecycle ownership rather than direct PID identity: an invocation-owned process domain, shared timeout/cancellation teardown and bounded cleanup can close the demonstrated descendant/pipeline hang, but terminal evidence must remain narrower than claims about escaped descendants, non-POSIX trees or external effects. No prior-day research input, fixed article outline, forced first-party mapping, article drafting, visualization, Publication Candidate creation or publication was used or performed.
workResult.summary_zh: 在完成 Fail-closed Admission、权威 Generated Analysis Prompt 的 SHA-256 确定性核验、全部 7 个 Required Control/Editorial/Evidence Source 的完整读取、同日 Wake Receipt 持久核验、仓库授予的全局串行执行权与 Worker Claimed 核验后，仅执行 Skill 04 Research Analysis。只消费 2026-08-29 当日三份已完成 Reading Result，并恰好形成三份 Research Object。Q-20260829-01 的判断是：可恢复 Agent Runtime 应把 Reconstruction Authority 与 Execution Authority 分离；符合资格且存活的完整 WorldState Snapshot 可以合法恢复 Context Continuity，更弱或已被 Compaction 淘汰的 State 应被拒绝，但携带 Permission 的恢复状态在执行前仍需要按当前 Policy/Resource 重新核验。Q-20260829-02 的判断是：只有 Workspace Trust 直接改变 Capability Admission 时才成为可执行 Governance；Negative 或 Unresolved Trust 应在 Capability Materialization 前收窄 Effective Executable Surface，而对 Already-created Capability 的 Live Revocation 仍是另一项 Lifecycle Control。Q-20260829-03 的判断是：Bounded Execution 必须沿 Lifecycle Ownership 而不是 Direct PID Identity；Invocation-owned Process Domain、共享 Timeout/Cancellation Teardown 与有界 Cleanup 能关闭已证明的 Descendant/Pipe Hang，但 Terminal Evidence 不能扩大成对 Escaped Descendant、Non-POSIX Tree 或 External Effect 已全部消失的证明。未复用前一日研究输入，也未使用固定文章大纲、强行映射自有项目，未执行文章撰写、可视化、Publication Candidate 创建或发布。

researchObjects.judgment: A durable snapshot may be authoritative enough to reconstruct context without being authoritative enough to authorize action. Resumable Agent runtimes should keep reconstruction evidence, lineage/freshness identity and current execution authorization separately inspectable, and revalidate permission-bearing restored state before it can shape capabilities or effects.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Durable Snapshot 可以足以授权 Context Reconstruction，却仍不足以授权 Action。可恢复 Agent Runtime 应让 Reconstruction Evidence、Lineage/Freshness Identity 与当前 Execution Authorization 保持可独立检查，并在携带 Permission 的恢复状态影响 Capability 或 Effect 前重新核验。

researchObjects.judgment: Workspace trust becomes an enforceable authority boundary when its result is coupled to capability admission. Negative or unresolved authority should reduce the effective executable surface before materialization; revoking capability instances that already exist is a separate lifecycle responsibility and is not proven by configuration-time filtering.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 当 Workspace Trust Result 与 Capability Admission 绑定时，它才成为可执行 Authority Boundary。Negative 或 Unresolved Authority 应在 Materialization 前缩小 Effective Executable Surface；已经存在的 Capability Instance 如何撤销属于独立 Lifecycle Responsibility，不能由 Configuration-time Filtering 自动证明。

researchObjects.judgment: Bounded execution should follow lifecycle ownership beyond the direct process. The demonstrated POSIX pattern establishes an invocation-owned process group, shares timeout/cancellation teardown and bounds cleanup itself; terminal evidence should distinguish bounded cleanup of the owned domain from stronger, unproven claims that escaped descendants or external effects are certainly gone.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Bounded Execution 应沿 Lifecycle Ownership 延伸到 Direct Process 之外。已展示的 POSIX Pattern 建立 Invocation-owned Process Group，让 Timeout/Cancellation 共享 Teardown，并给 Cleanup 本身设定上界；Terminal Evidence 应区分“Owned Domain 已完成有界 Cleanup”和“Escaped Descendant 或 External Effect 已确定消失”这种更强但未被证明的结论。
